title: Director, Product Legal (EmFi & Payments)
description:

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,300 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 

HOW YOU'LL MAKE IMPACT

Product Legal is an embedded partner to Airwallex’s product organization, helping shape regulated financial products from early ideation through launch. In this role, you’ll lead the legal support for Embedded Finance, Lending, Issuing, and Payments for Platforms while staying close to the highest-impact product and commercial matters.

- Lead the product-legal team supporting Embedded Finance, Lending, Issuing, and Payments for Platforms, managing two direct reports while remaining closely involved in the highest-impact matters.

- Structure novel Embedded Finance and Lending models for strategic enterprise customers, partnering with Enterprise Sales, Product, Financial Partnerships, Risk, Regulatory Compliance, Engineering, and bank partners.

- Coordinate with Regulatory Legal, Data & Privacy, Risk, FCC, Commercial Legal, Global Expansion & Licensing, and regional product legal leads on product launches, GRC escalations, and regulatory exam responses.

- Serve as the U.S.-based point person for Embedded Finance, own the Lending portfolio, provide secondary support for Issuing, and help the Product Legal team scale its impact beyond one-to-one deal support.

- Help Airwallex deliver Product Legal Readiness for prioritized launches across markets including Canada, Mexico, Brazil, and the UAE.

- Support customer-facing legal-to-legal discussions and bring deep fintech regulatory credibility to complex commercial opportunities.

You'll work from our San Francisco or New York office on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays.

title: Algorithms Engineer, Power Applications
description:
Karman is a fast-growing NVIDIA-backed AI company enabling AI data centers to dynamically orchestrate power and unlock more compute capacity from existing energy infrastructure. For over a decade, we have applied AI to the electric grid, bringing real-time visibility and power-flow control to complex energy infrastructure. Our Karman platform, built on a custom NVIDIA module, brings that same capability to AI data centers, giving operators a way to better use the power already available to them.

The Power Applications team takes power orchestration algorithms from idea to production. We develop, ship, and maintain the applications that run on Karman to orchestrate closed-loop control actions and deliver quantifiable customer value. This is a hands-on, end-to-end role. As a Senior Algorithms Engineer, you will develop and deliver these control algorithms, working day to day with the principal engineer who owns our control architecture. You will develop the theory behind our algorithms, validate them against real hardware and realistic workloads, implement them in production code alongside our software engineers, and stay with them in the field, measuring, tuning, and improving them release after release.

Your time will be split between improving the algorithms already in production and R&D for the next iterations of the product, from smarter forecasting and online learning to orchestration across larger portions of a data center and new generations of GPU hardware.

Strong candidates come from many paths. Some lean toward control theory and estimation, others toward building and hardening real-time systems. Both are welcome. What we require is rigor, a systems mindset, and the drive to see your work shipped and owned.

Responsibilities

• Design, analyze, and deliver improvements to the control and orchestration algorithms that allocate and enforce power across servers, racks, and rows at high speed and with hard reliability guarantees

• Own algorithms end to end: theory and prototyping (Python), production implementation (Rust and Python), validation, deployment, and ongoing tuning in the field

• Help to define how we measure algorithm performance, from adherence to electrical limits to impact on compute throughput, and build the benchmark and regression suites that hold each release to that bar

• Continuously improve the performance, robustness, and operability of the algorithm-driven services already in production

• Drive R&D that de-risks and shapes future product iterations (forecasting, automated parameter tuning, orchestration at larger scales, new compute and actuation hardware), running experiments in our lab and pilot environments and turning results into clear decisions

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, computer science, applied mathematics, physics, mechanical or aerospace engineering, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience

• Deep expertise in control systems and mathematical optimization, including feedback control, state estimation, and the practical realities of latency, noise, and missing data, ideally in distributed or edge settings

• A track record of taking algorithms from concept to production in physical systems, owning their performance once deployed, and designing them to fit the whole system rather than optimizing components in isolation

• Strong Python skills for prototyping and analysis (e.g. pyspark, tensorflow, pytorch) and the ability to work in production codebases in a systems language (we use Rust, and will support you in learning it)

• Comfort in a continuous delivery environment: working directly in production repositories, writing tests, reviewing code, and using field performance data to understand and improve algorithms

• Excellent written communication and the habits of a strong remote teammate: proactive updates, thorough documentation, empathy, and assuming good intent

• Willingness to travel up to 10% of the t

For over a decade, we have applied AI to the electric grid - bringing real-time visibility and power-flow control to complex energy infrastructure. We are looking for an Application Engineer, Data Center Hardware to own the electrical power integration surface between Karman and customer data center environments. This person will design and validate rack-level power distribution, redundancy, and sequencing configurations, and lead the installation procedures that get Karman running reliably in production. The role requires solid working knowledge of rack-level networking to coordinate with customer network teams and support installation-time connectivity, but architecting network solutions is not a primary responsibility of this role. We are looking for candidates who are technically deep in electrical power systems, comfortable owning ambiguity, and energized by close, hands-on customer engagement. title: Quantitative Researcher
description:

hermeneutic research is a best-in-class proprietary trading firm. It deploys research-driven discretionary and systematic strategies as well as makes strategic long-term investments. The partners' decade-long history of success in trading and business building and a firm-wide cultural emphasis on alpha generation, open debate, relentless iteration, and teamwork are key to the firm's continued expansion in a challenging market environment that has hamstrung competitors. A hard-wired emphasis on risk management and opportunistic market participation ensures that hermeneutic research will continue its growth trajectory in the coming decades.
Job Overview
As a Quantitative Researcher at hermeneutic research, you will develop and improve systematic trading strategies across digital asset markets.
You will work across the full research lifecycle: identifying market inefficiencies, developing hypotheses, analyzing large-scale market data, building predictive signals and trading models, designing robust backtests, and helping to monetise successful research and improve firm-wide execution quality.
This role will be grounded in real market behavior and production trading data. You will work extensively with tick market data, order book and trade data, execution data, and portfolio-level performance to identify market inefficiencies, test hypotheses, and determine whether observed patterns are robust and tradable.
You will join a team with high-frequency/systematic trading and market making background, whose strategies that naturally enable improvement of firm-wide execution quality. You will collaborate closely with traders, quantitative researchers, and engineers while retaining significant ownership of your own research. Successful researchers are expected not only to develop sophisticated models, but also to identify the questions that matter, design rigorous experiments, challenge assumptions, and translate findings into economically meaningful improvements to live trading.
This is an opportunity for a strong quantitative researcher to work in a highly collaborative environment with access to substantial data, technology and trading infrastructure.
Key Responsibilities

• Research, develop and optimize systematic trading strategies and signals across digital asset markets.

• Analyze high-frequency market data, including trades, order books, derivatives data, and cross-venue market activity, to identify exploitable market structure and behavioral patterns.

• Formulate research hypotheses and design statistically rigorous experiments to evaluate them.

• Build robust backtesting and simulation frameworks while carefully accounting for transaction costs, market impact, latency, liquidity, and other real-world trading constraints.

• Research market microstructure, liquidity dynamics, price formation, execution behavior, and short-horizon alpha.

• Develop quantitative models for signal generation, execution, portfolio construction, and risk management.

• Evaluate existing strategies and identify opportunities to improve alpha, execution quality and robustness.

• Work closely with engineers to translate successful research into reliable production trading systems.

• Monitor live strategy performance and investigate discrepancies between research, simulation, and production results.

• Continuously improve research methodologies, datasets, tooling, and experimental standards across the quantitative research process.

• Strong quantitative and statistical reasoning, with the ability to translate ambiguous market questions into testable hypotheses.

• Strong programming ability, particularly in Python, with experience analyzing large datasets and building quantitative research pipelines.

title: Senior Fullstack Mobile Engineer
description:
ABOUT US:

Tebi is creating the first Connected Restaurant Management System that makes hospitality flow. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen prep, payments, and all the data that powers it, creating smooth service and intuitive insights.

Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is built in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Italy, Spain, Germany, Denmark and Finland already love running on Tebi.

 

ABOUT THE ROLE:

We’re looking for a seasoned Fullstack Mobile Engineer to help shape the core experience for thousands of restaurant teams. This is a senior role focused on building performant, polished applications across mobile platforms.

You’ll lead development of cross-platform features, collaborate closely with design and product, and contribute to shared backend components when needed. You should bring a strong product mindset, care deeply about developer experience, and be excited about building better software, faster.

This role is ideal for someone who has experience shipping real-world apps, and is looking to make high-impact technical decisions in a fast-moving team.

 

Our Tech Stack: We use Kotlin multiplatform and Jetpack Compose. Everything runs in GCP and our database it’s Postgres.

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

- Work on the development of our app architecture across Android and iOS

- Design and implement shared business logic and client code, as well as platform-specific UI components where needed

- Work closely with designers, PMs, and other engineers to deliver intuitive, delightful product experiences

- Contribute to backend services where necessary, ensuring tight integration and performance across the stack

- Continuously improve build tooling, developer experience, and code quality

- Play a critical role in shaping how Tebi scales across new markets, languages, and user types

 

WHAT YOU BRING:

- 7+ years of experience in software engineering, with deep expertise in mobile engineering

- Strong experience building and shipping Android apps; familiarity with iOS and multiplatform development patterns.

- Strong experience with Kotlin

- Comfortable owning architecture decisions and collaborating with cross-functional teams to ship features

- A strong product mindset, you care about solving real problems for users, not just writing code

- Great communication skills and a pragmatic approach to building scalable systems

If this speaks to you we can be the right fit. Learn more about how we work from our Recipe here: https://www.tebi.com/gb/careers.

 

BENEFITS:

- Start-up Equity

- Competitive Salary

- Lunch Provided in Office

- Team building events

- Unlimited time off

Note: Interviews will start after the 14th of September.

 

What is Restaurant Software?

Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it.

From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy.

 

How we use AI at Tebi

We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed.

At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn’t make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it.

description:

The role

We're looking for Registered Nurse (RN) Contractors to support Maple 's labs and referrals operations-helping patients receive timely follow-up and clear guidance based on lab results and specialist referrals issued through the Maple platform.

In this role, you'll work remotely and contribute on an as-needed basis, supporting periods of higher volume and continuity across our clinical operations. You'll use your clinical judgment, work independently and help patients take the next step in their care.

Your responsibilities

As a Registered Nurse (RN) Contractor, you will:

• Contact patients directly when critical results require immediate emergency care.

• Escalate complex cases to physicians when appropriate.

• Support specialist referrals based on clinical directives, including preparing referral documentation and required forms.

• Assign referrals to appropriate specialist clinics based on patient location, clinical need and specialty.

• Redirect referrals when clinics are unresponsive or decline them.

• Review specialist consult reports and determine whether patient follow-up is required.

• Support additional workstreams outside this list, depending on scheduling and operational needs.

What you bring

• Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BScN).

• Current registration and good standing with a Canadian provincial or territorial nursing college.

• No active malpractice investigations and professional liability coverage in place.

• Experience in a patient-facing clinical setting-primary care, medical-surgical or emergency care preferred.

• Strong clinical judgment and confidence reviewing lab results and specialist documentation.

• Comfort working independently in a remote, technology-enabled environment.

• Proficiency using Mac devices and learning new digital tools quickly.

• Excellent English communication skills, written and verbal.

• Bilingual proficiency in French is a significant asset, but not required.

• Strong understanding of patient privacy and confidentiality requirements.

The details

• Job type: Independent contractor with variable hours based on operational demand. Most RN contractors are expected to support 10-20 hours per week on average, depending on volume and availability.

• Hiring manager: Manager, Care Delivery Operations

• Location: Fully remote within Canada

• Start date: November 2026

• Pay rate: $35 hourly

Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. title: Founding iOS Engineer (m/f/d)

title: Data Privacy Manager
description:
The Data Privacy Manager (“Privacy Manager”) is responsible for managing, co-ordinating and generally implementing KLDiscovery ’s data protection strategy and ensuring compliance with applicable data protection laws, including the General Data Protection Regulation (“GDPR”), the UK Data Protection Act 2018 and US State privacy laws including the California Consumer Privacy Act (“CCPA”) and Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (“HIPAA”). The Privacy Manager will act as the internal lead for KLDiscovery on data privacy queries, serves as the primary point of contact for data subjects and regulatory authorities, provides expert advice on data protection matters, undertakes implementation of data privacy initiatives, ensures compliance with KLDiscovery policies and supports KLDiscovery in managing risks associated with the processing of personal data for clients and employees.

Key Responsibilities

Compliance Monitoring and Advisory

• Monitor compliance against global data protection laws and internal policies, procedures, and controls, both for clients and employees.

• Advise KLDiscovery and its employees on data protection obligations and best practices.

• Monitor emerging trends, legislative changes, and guidance relating to data privacy, particularly involving use of artificial-intelligence.

Risk and Assessment

• Conduct regular audits, risk assessments, and reviews of data processing activities including vendor due diligence as it relates Data Privacy Assessments.

• Co-ordinate and manage Data Protection Impact Assessments (“DPIAs”), Transfer Impact Assessments (“TIAs”), Legitimate Interest Assessments (‘’LIAs’’) and advise on mitigating risks for both product and internal initiatives.

• Maintain KLDiscovery ’s compliance with cross‑border data transfer requirements, including the Data Privacy Framework (“DPF”), Schrems II obligations, and any successor or equivalent transfer mechanisms.

Records and Documentation

• Own and maintain the Records of Processing Activities (“ROPA”) as required by law on a per country basis, covering all business units.

• Develop and maintain data protection policies, privacy notices, and supporting documentation.

• Assist in development of contractual frameworks for clients and providing advice on best practices.

Data Subject and Regulatory Liaison

• Serve as the primary contact for data subjects regarding data protection queries, complaints, and requests, including Subject Access Requests (“SARs”), with responses managed within applicable statutory timeframes and data deletion.

• Act as the primary liaison with supervisory authorities and facilitate communication in the event of a data breach or investigation.

• Support the cybersecurity incident response process by providing expert guidance on breach classification, notification obligations, and regulatory reporting requirements across applicable jurisdictions including GDPR, HIPAA, DORA, NIS2, and US state laws.

Governance, Training and Awareness

• Deliver KLDiscovery ’s data protection training and awareness programme.

• Monitoring changes in privacy laws and advising the organization accordingly.

• Client and commercial support answering data privacy questions from clients as part of client RFPs and due diligence process and questionnaires.

• Support KLD's AI governance framework and EU AI Act compliance readiness, including reviewing AI-driven data processing activities for privacy risk and control adequacy.

Qualifications and Experience

• Professional certification in data protection or privacy (e.g., CIPP/E, CIPM, GDPR Practitioner).

description:
ABOUT NU

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en

TEAM CONTEXT

The AI Transformation Office (AITO), part of AI Core, is Nubank's central office driving the company-wide AI transformation. We orchestrate all of the AI workstreams - including function transformation, infrastructure, AI risk, AI cost and communications - and work directly with Nubank's management team and senior leaders across the company.

 

ABOUT THE ROLE

You join a small core team as the person who brings the outside view: first-hand experience of how an AI plays a key role at a company that is further along. You'll use it to shape where Nubank's transformation goes next, decide which AI solutions we build or buy, and structure how progress reaches the management team - while staying hands-on enough to unblock the initiatives that matter most.

Impact: you will shape the direction, reach and quality of Nubank's AI transformation.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Shape Nubank's AI strategy with industry learnings. Bring what worked and failed at top players to define where Nubank goes next - what to double down on, what to stop, how to sequence it, and which operating model fits.

- Define our AI solutions portfolio. Map the AI solutions we have internally and support build-vs-buy calls - which tools, harnesses and context layers Nubank should build in-house versus source externally - and shape the scope of the ones we build.

- Own the management team narrative. Structure what goes to Nubank's management team every week - turning signals from every workstream into a clear picture of progress, risks and the decisions needed.

- Define what success looks like. Set ambitious targets for our AI initiatives and the KPIs, measures, and mechanisms that show whether they are actually delivering impact.

- Unblock critical initiatives. When something is stuck, go into the team, understand the blocker and resolve it - across functions, without formal authority.

- Run the operating rhythm. Lead weekly workstream sessions with initiative owners on gaps, ETAs and resourcing; connect cross-workstream dependencies and escalate risks early.

BENEFITS

• Opportunity of earning equity at Nu
• Medical Insurance
• Dental and Vision Insurance
• Life Insurance and AD&D
• Extended maternity and paternity leaves
• Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses
• NuLanguage - Our language learning program
• NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program
• 401K Saving Plans - Health Saving Account and Flexible Spending Account
• Work-from-home Allowance
• Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable

WORK MODEL:

Hybrid 2-3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

Our recruitment process may involve the use of artificial intelligence-enabled tools, such as automated interview transcription and analysis, to support the evaluation process. Artificial intelligence is not used to make final hiring decisions; all decisions are made by human reviewers.

title: Member of Technical Staff, Data & Evals
description:
WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth - personal, professional, and financial - is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission - operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today - and we’re just getting started.

ROLE OVERVIEW

As a Member of Technical Staff, Data & Evals in Harvey Research, you’ll build the data and measurement systems that power our post-training, benchmarking, and agent capability efforts.

We recently post-trained our first model built for legal work, and we’re now building the team to scale up our post-training efforts. You’ll own synthetic data pipelines, evaluation design, the tasks and grading behind training environments, and the systems that turn feedback from domain experts into training signals and rewards. These are tasks where correctness often can’t be verified automatically, so defining and measuring quality is a core research challenge. You’ll join a small, high-bar team of hands-on engineers and researchers, where each person owns a large part of the work.

We’re looking for research engineers who can build reliable data and evaluation systems, question what a metric actually tells us, and work closely with researchers and legal experts to turn model failures into measurable improvements.

Learn more about our work at harvey.ai/research http://harvey.ai/research.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Build synthetic data pipelines that generate, filter, and curate training and evaluation samples for complex legal reasoning and agentic workflows.

- Design evaluations and verifiers that reflect real legal work, calibrate them against expert judgment, and investigate where they fail.

- Build and maintain capability benchmarks like our Legal Agent Benchmark (LAB), along with product-focused evals that track how models perform on real customer workflows.

- Work with legal domain experts to define quality metrics, rubrics, and other grading mechanisms for training and evaluation.

- Own training and evaluation data quality, including provenance, coverage, and safeguards against contamination.

- Close the loop from product usage and customer feedback to new evaluations and training data, so models improve where customers need them most.

- Partner with researchers to investigate model failures, distinguish real gains from misleading metrics, and use findings to guide training and release decisions.

WHAT YOU HAVE

- Experience building data pipelines, ML evaluation systems, or experimentation tooling, with strong Python skills and ownership of production-quality code.

- A rigorous approach to measurement, including statistical reasoning, experimental design, and understanding when a metric can mislead.

- The ability to translate ambiguous goals or expert judgment into structured datasets, rubrics, and measurable criteria.

- Experience with synthetic data, LLM evaluations, automated raters, or preference data is a plus. Strong data and measurement engineering experience close to ML model development is valuable even without prior LL

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life - or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

As a Senior Backend Engineer II in the Zen team, you will be responsible for building the systems that help keep counterfeit items off Vinted, while protecting legitimate sellers.

• Measure the impact of what we ship, with accuracy and fairness to legitimate sellers in mind.

• Raise the bar for engineering and agentic development by mentoring engineers in the team and beyond.

About you 

• Proven experience designing, building and operating ML- and data-driven backend systems in production, with Go, Ruby or Python, including event-driven systems.

• Curiosity and drive to explore and apply AI to counterfeit detection, staying on top of the latest developments in LLMs and their practical applications.

• Solid understanding of data, ML and LLMs: how models are trained, evaluated and retrained, and how to build reliable systems around them.

• Comfortable working with data and decision scientists, using data to make decisions and contributing valuable engineering input.

• Demonstrated ability to own complex, ambiguous problems end to end and drive technical decisions.

• Pragmatic about trade-offs between catching abuse and protecting legitimate sellers, and able to explain technical decisions to non-engineers.

title: Medical Monitor - CNS
description:
The Medical Monitor (MM) plays a critical role in overseeing the safety and efficacy of clinical trials, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, providing medical oversight, and performing medical data reviews to ensure patient safety and data integrity. Collaborates with Project Manager, Safety/Pharmacovigilance (PvG), Data Management, Biostatistics, QA, Principal Investigator and Sub-investigators, Site Coordinators, the Data Monitoring Committee (DMC), and any other group that directly or indirectly protects the safety of study participants.

Clinical Trial Medical Oversight: Provide medical, scientific, and safety oversight for clinical trials, ensuring protocol adherence, participant safety, eligibility, IP dosing, and management of AEs/SAEs/SUSARs, with 24/7 coverage and backup support as needed.

Site & Investigator Support: Serve as the primary medical point of contact for investigators, site staff, and sponsors; participate in site selection, SIVs, investigator meetings, site visits, and protocol deviation and root‑cause assessments.

Trial Design & Cross‑Functional Collaboration: Provide medical input into protocol development and amendments, clinical development plans, study reports, and scientific presentations, working closely with Clinical Operations, Project Management, and other departments.

description:
Your Role

As a Defect Inspection Engineer/Expert, you will be responsible for ensuring the defect-free quality of semiconductor wafers using Automated Optical Inspection (AOI) systems and unpatterned wafer inspection.

You will detect defects such as particles, scratches, haze, and surface roughness that could impact the yield of our integrated graphene photonics process flow. Working in a cleanroom environment, you will collaborate with process, equipment and integration teams to set up, qualify and optimize inspection recipes, troubleshoot issues, and continuously improve defect detection and classification.

What You’ll Do

- Perform AOI and unpatterned wafer inspection on materials such as bare silicon, epitaxial layers and polished wafers

- Set up, qualify and optimize inspection recipes

- Fine-tune inspection tool and recipe parameters to improve defect-detection sensitivity, inspection quality, repeatability and overall performance

- Analyze defect data to identify trends, root causes and potential process excursions

- Interpret defect data and translate findings into actionable insights for process teams

- Generate defect maps, Pareto charts and reports to communicate findings

- Participate in Design of Experiments (DOE) to optimize inspection parameters

- Troubleshoot inspection-related issues and support continuous improvement in defect detection and classification

- Collaborate with process, equipment and integration teams

What You Bring

- A bachelor’s degree or above in electrical engineering, materials science, physics or a related field

- 5+ years of experience in semiconductor inspection, with a focus on AOI and unpatterned wafer inspection

- Hands-on experience with unpatterned wafer inspection systems, such as SPx, and AOI tools such as Eagle or Dragonfly

- Understanding of semiconductor process flows, including polishing, epitaxy and cleaning

- Familiarity with defect classification, SEM review and Statistical Process Control (SPC)

- Proficiency in AOI and defect-review software, such as KLA Klarity and Camtek Inspecta

- Ability to optimize inspection tools and recipe parameters for sensitivity, inspection quality and repeatability

- Ability to interpret defect data and identify relevant trends and improvement opportunities

- Proficiency in JMP for statistical analysis, data visualization and DOE

- Familiarity with MATLAB or Python is an advantage

- Excellent communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to collaborate across functions

What We Offer

- The opportunity to work on defect inspection for an integrated graphene photonics process flow

- A cleanroom-based role with close collaboration across process, equipment and integration teams

title: Site Manager
description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

THE DATA CENTER OPERATIONS TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

- Operate at the scale of a nation, not a building. The fleet you run will draw more power than some countries, on the way to 10s of GW.

- Fly the plane while it's being built. Sites come online in pieces, and you keep the live ones running flawlessly while construction continues around them.

- Write the playbook, don't inherit it. No prior operations org has run at this speed and scale, so the standards you set become the standard.

ROLE SCOPE

- Lead 24/7/365 operation of all critical infrastructure at your site: electrical distribution (UPS, generators, switchgear), mechanical and liquid cooling, fire/life safety, and building controls, accountable for availability against customer SLAs.

- Own site safety in partnership with HSE, including hazardous energy control, electrical safety, and LOTO discipline across a mixed employee and contractor workforce.

- Build and lead the full site team, facility operators alongside hardware and network operators, owning shift coverage, on-call rotations, performance, and development.

- Run the hardware and network repair operation: own the ticket queues, drive triage, prioritization, break-fix, and RMA workflows, and hold time-to-repair against customer commitments as the fleet scales.

- Run incident and change management for the site: lead severity response as the escalation point, deliver root cause analyses on 5 and 10 day clocks, and drive corrective actions that fix classes of problems, not instances.

- Partner with construction, commissioning, colo providers, and utilities while the site is live and still being built, driving operational readiness, MOP and SOO rigor, and clean handover into operations.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Overview
Patchstack protects WordPress sites for hosts, agencies and developers, and we're now launching a security product for people building JavaScript apps with AI tools like Claude Code. That product is early. We have good signals from hosts and hackathons, but we haven't yet found who it serves best, what they value, or why they'll keep paying for it.
You'll be the product manager who finds that out. You'll talk to customers, use the product in real AI-assisted workflows, test ideas quickly with our designer and engineers, and build the measurement that tells us what's working. You'll work alongside two small engineering squads, a senior product designer, QA and infrastructure. You own which customer problems we invest in and how we learn from the results.
About you
You're happiest early, before the answers exist. You'd rather run a small test this week than wait for perfect data. You're comfortable in a terminal and have built things with AI-assisted tools, so you can use our product the way our customers do. You form your own view on technical claims rather than taking "it's not feasible" or "the metric improved" at face value. You say what you think, including when it's awkward, and you change your mind when the evidence says so. You work well in a flat team with little process, and you help people around you get better rather than taking work off them.
Responsibilities

• Run customer discovery for the JavaScript product: interviews, observed usage, support and event feedback, and your own hands-on use.

• With Growth and Product Marketing, recommend which customers and problems to focus on, backed by evidence of who uses, who pays and why.

• Shape what we build with the Senior Product Designer from early discovery through testing. You own the problem and intended outcome; they own the design response.

• Agree outcomes and priorities with the engineering squads and help them turn validated problems into work. Squads own delivery.

• Build and ship small prototypes, experiments and product changes yourself where that's the fastest way to learn, within our review and QA process.

• Own product measurement in PostHog: define the actions that matter, get tracking in place, and combine the numbers with customer evidence to explain what's working.

• Keep what we've learned, decided and assumed visible in Notion so the team can make good investment calls.

• Raise risks, gaps and decisions early, and escalate anything beyond your remit.

Requirements

• Experience as a product manager on a technical or developer-facing product, ideally pre or early product-market fit.

• Examples of changing or stopping a product direction based on customer and technical evidence you gathered yourself.

• Hands-on with AI-assisted development, the command line, packages and dependencies. You don't need to be a production engineer, but you need to be at home in that environment.

• Strong customer research and data analysis skills, including building useful measurement from little reliable data.

• Clear, direct communication with designers, engineers and leadership in a remote, low-process team.

Benefits

• €75-100k salary, depending on location and experience, plus company stock options

• 4.5-day working week (half-day Fridays)

• Remote-first, with reasonable overlap with EU timezones

• 38 days' paid time off a year (including public holidays) plus 3 health days

• Company laptop, and co-working membership or home-office equipment

• AI tooling budget

• Quarterly health and wellness allowance

• Travel for conferences, events and our annual company meetup

title: Senior Software Engineer (.NET Ecosystem)

The Integrations Ecosystem org builds the drivers, SDKs, connectors and BI integrations that make ClickHouse feel native in any stack. We're looking for a product-minded engineer to own the ClickHouse .NET client. You'll decide what the client should do by talking to the developers who use it, reading the issues and the telemetry, and listening to the community. Then you'll build it, with deep .NET expertise, and measure whether it worked. Your scope is the SDK and what builds on it: ADO.NET http://ADO.NET, Dapper and Entity Framework Core users, and the tools and integrations that depend on your client.

- Shape the client for agents as users: an API, docs and error messages an AI coding agent can use correctly on the first try.

title: Senior Product Manager - Data Products
description:
WE POWER PEOPLE’S PROGRESS.

At Preply, we’re all about creating life-changing learning experiences. We help people discover the magic of the perfect tutor, craft a personalised learning journey, and stay motivated to keep growing. Our approach is human-led, tech-enabled - and it’s creating real impact.

We’ve just reached unicorn status with a $150M Series D, accelerating our vision to transform education through human-led, AI-enhanced learning. Today, 100,000+ tutors teach 90+ languages to learners in 180 countries - and we’re only getting started. As a category-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale.

Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day.

Meet the team!

Every great learning experience at Preply starts with great data. Our data product team builds foundational data products from governed, reusable data models and semantic layers. They power analytics, AI (classic ML and LLMs) and the necessary context for agentic products, helping Preply drive growth, innovate faster and become a truly AI-native company.

We’re a new function with a greenfield mandate, working alongside a high-calibre product and engineering organisation, and you’ll be the first product manager dedicated to shaping what we build and in what order.

What you’ll be doing

Ownership: Shape and build the foundational data products for a fast-growing learning platform and marketplace, and modernise our data foundations and data platforms so every team can build on data that is trusted, governed and AI-ready.

Strategy and roadmap: Decide which data products to build and in what order. Spot opportunities with business and product teams, especially those that build our data moat, and make sure the data we build gets adopted and used.

Partners: Work hand in hand with analytics engineering, data science, engineering, product, finance and business teams.

Success: Prove the return on our data products by showing how they drive company and product outcomes and business performance.

What you need to succeed

- Experience in a senior product role, with proven experience building data products.

- Demonstrated business impact from data products, backed by tangible examples.

- Strong product craft: you plan and run an agile product process, build roadmaps, define metrics, coordinate stakeholders and make complex trade-offs with sound judgement.

- Experience working with data engineers or analytics engineers.

- A track record of driving adoption through compelling, high-quality data products that people choose to use, and of demoing new ways to use data that unlock new products and business experiences.

- Working knowledge of SQL, data governance tools and modern data platforms.

Nice to have

- Experience leading data modernisation transformations.

- Experience building company-wide agentic analytics

Why you'll enjoy working at Preply:

- An open, collaborative, dynamic, and diverse culture

- A generous monthly allowance for lessons on Preply.com http://Preply.com

- Learning & Development budget and time off for your self-development

- A competitive financial package with equity, leave allowance, and health insurance

- Attractive relocation package for those not in Barcelona to join us in our Preply Barcelona Hub

- Access to free mental health support platforms

- Access to Gympass-partnered wellness and gym centers throughout Spain to promote and support well-being and physical health

- The opportunity to unlock the potential of learners and tutors through language learning and teaching in 175 countries (and counting!)

OUR PRINCIPLES

- Care to change the world - We are passionate about our work and care deeply about its impact to be life changing.

- We do it for learners - For both Preply and tutors, learners

title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
description:
ABOUT NU

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en

ABOUT THE ROLE

Nu runs a twelve-year-old platform that has never stopped growing: thousands of microservices, low-latency payment rails, large-scale data platforms, machine learning in the critical path, and one mobile app carrying a dozen financial products across several regulated markets. We are expanding into new countries, new lines of business and new interfaces, including AI agents that act on customers’ behalf. Many of the systems we need for that don’t exist yet.

We’re hiring Senior Staff Software Engineers to be the technical reference for an area of the business. You’ll find the problems worth solving, design and ship the solutions, and raise the bar for the teams around you. If Staff is about making a team succeed, Senior Staff is about making an organization succeed. You’ll be matched to a specific team based on your depth and interests. Current areas include agentic and AI-native banking, payments and money movement, fraud, identity and risk, core banking, and platform and infrastructure.

YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

- Leading complex, ambiguous, strategic initiatives end to end, from setting the technical direction through to code running in production.

- Spotting the problems worth solving in your area and delivering scalable solutions that change business results and strategy, not just roadmap items.

- Shaping your area’s mid- to long-term strategy with product and business leaders, then turning it into a technical roadmap others can build on.

- Making high-stakes architecture decisions where no clear precedent exists, and guiding teams through the trade-offs.

- Setting standards beyond your own team, including design guidelines, quality bars and reusable components that other squads adopt.

- Mentoring senior engineers, managers and peers across teams. You’ll also take part in hiring and lead or sponsor guilds.

- Representing Nu in technical conversations with external partners, platforms and vendors.

WE’RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO HAS

Required

- Extensive experience at Staff level or above (or equivalent) designing, building and running high-scale, mission-critical systems.

- A track record of leading initiatives across organizational boundaries with little formal authority, and of seeing them land.

- Evidence that you ship. You still write code and validate architecture in production.

- Strong judgment in ambiguous situations, and a history of building systems from scratch as well as evolving large ones you inherited.

- The ability to explain complex technical strategy clearly to engineers, product partners and senior leadership, and to build alignment around it.

- A pragmatic, hands-on approach to AI. You use it to get more done, and you measure what it actually delivers.

- Professional fluency in English.

Nice to have

- Experience in payments, card networks, fraud and risk, or digital banking.

- Experience building consumer-facing products at scale, with real product and UX sensibility.

- Experience in regulated or otherwise unforgiving environments, where correctness matters more than speed.

- Experience with LLMs, agent platforms or protocols such as MCP.

- Portuguese or Spanish.

- Clojure or functional programming experience. It’s our primary backend language, but it isn’t required: every engineer goes through an immersive Clojure onboarding.

LOCATIONS

Palo Alto, CA, USA · Miami, FL, USA · McLean, VA, USA · Toronto, ON, Canada · São Paulo, Brazil

title: Founding Sales Development Representative (Spain)
description:
Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send thousands of payouts to anyone, anywhere, for free. We're trusted by 20,000 organizations like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way to deliver gift cards and money to millions of recipients worldwide.

Our customers (researchers, marketers, HR teams, nonprofits, and platform businesses) rave about how fast and easy Tremendous is to use. Check out our ratings on G2 https://www.g2.com/products/tremendous/reviews.

Tremendous is profitable and growing without outside investors. We're a fully remote, high-documentation, low-meeting culture, which means more time for what matters in both your professional and personal life. The team agrees- our employee NPS is in the high 80s.

About the role

We’re looking for a Founding European SDR to help launch and scale Tremendous’ outbound motion internationally. As one of our first international SDR hire, you’ll be responsible for identifying, engaging, and booking meetings with high-potential prospects, while helping define how we sell into new European markets.

You will partner closely with Account Executives to generate meetings and act as the first point of contact for prospective customers. This role requires strong outbound execution across email, phone, social, events, and field marketing, with meaningful ownership over account development and early market strategy.

As a founding hire, you will have the opportunity to shape messaging, process, and best practices for international sales while directly impacting pipeline, revenue growth, and Tremendous’ expansion internationally.

What you'll do

- Work primarily to bring in new deals through outbound prospecting for the Southern European Market

- Own your pipeline through cold calling first. The phone is your primary weapon; you'll be expected to make 80+ cold calls per day, book meetings over the phone, and treat every unanswered call as the next opportunity to dial again. Email and LinkedIn support your outreach; they don't replace it

- Collaborate with Account Executives, as well as members of our Marketing, Strategy, and RevOps teams, to develop new strategies to build our sales pipeline and grow our business

- Use prospecting tools to research accounts, identify key contacts and craft targeted messaging

- Learn our technology and effectively communicate our value proposition. Work to understand their goals and challenges to better understand how we can help.

What you'll bring

- You're fluent in English as well as Spanish and Italian to engage prospects across southern Europe.

- You pick up the phone before you open email. Cold calling isn't something you tolerate - it's how you start your day, every day, without being told to.

- Demonstrated history of consistently exceeding personal and professional goals, with a strong commitment to excellence in all endeavors

- Curious, lifelong learner mindset with a passion for continuous improvement, staying updated on industry trends and best practices, and showing enthusiasm for applying newly acquired knowledge to improve job performance

- Customer-obsessed sales approach, demonstrating a deep commitment to understanding and addressing the unique needs of our clients

- Independent. We all work together to solve tough problems here at Tremendous, but taking pride in experimenting and finding your own answers is the best way to learn.

- Collaborative. When our SDRs uncover new trends and tactics that work to set meetings, they share them with their teammates so everyone can benefit.

- Ambitious. Ambition isn't a dirty word at Tremendous. We're a team of achievers collaborating on a fast-growing product and that means personal growth in both role and responsibility as well as tons of personal upside for you.

What's cool about the role

- Competitive pay and equity. Base salary for this role: €39k - €45k. OTE: €56k - €62k.

- Fully remote within Spain

- Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook

title: Talent Sourcer

About Us

Tebi is building a modern connected hospitality operating system that helps entrepreneurs run their business more intelligently and smoothly. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen, inventory, and payments (as well as all the data that powers it) helping to automate work, streamline operations, and give hospitality owners the clarity and time they need to focus on what matters the most: creating great guest experiences.

Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is build in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Spain, Italy, Denmark, Germany, Finland, and Ireland.

About the Role

You'll be the engine behind our hiring growth. Most of our roles don't fill from applications: great people have to be found, approached and convinced. As our Sourcing Specialist, you'll own the top of our hiring funnel for sales and engineering roles, from the first message to a candidate who's ready to meet the hiring manager.

You'll also own the candidate experience around it: fast replies, smooth scheduling and honest feedback. That's what makes the best people say yes to us. This is a specialist role: we're looking for someone who loves the search and wants to get really good at it. Our recruiters run interviews, offers and closing, so you can stay focused on finding great people.

What You’ll Do

- Build and run outbound pipelines for sales and engineering roles, especially in cities where Tebi isn't yet known (Munich, Hamburg, Cologne/Düsseldorf, Rome, Milan, Madrid, Barcelona, the Nordics)

- Write messages that get answers, and follow up without being annoying

- Run short intro calls and hand promising candidates to our recruiters with a clear summary, not just a profile link

- Work with our recruiters on the profile for each role: who we want, where they are, what would make them move

- Own your numbers (messages, replies, intro calls, candidates passed on, hires) and share them weekly

- Look after the candidates you source: answer quickly, and give honest feedback to those who don’t move forward after the intro call

- Keep Ashby clean and your hiring data trustworthy: every candidate tracked, every rejection reason filled in.

- Spot what's slowing our process down and fix it, or tell us what to change

What You’ll Need

- 3-5 years in sourcing or recruiting, agency or in-house, with real outbound experience

- A track record of finding people who weren't looking, with examples of roles you filled that way

- Comfort with Boolean search, LinkedIn Recruiter and Ashby

- Clear, direct writing and a good phone manner

- Reliable and organised: you don't let a candidate wait for a reply

- Curiosity about AI tools and how they can make sourcing faster and better

- Fluent in English. Dutch or other EU languages are a are a plus

People who succeed at Tebi are independent, curious and passionate about hospitality. If this speaks to you we can be the right fit. Learn more about how we work from our Recipe here: https://www.tebi.com/gb/careers https://www.tebi.com/gb/careers.

- Start-up equity

- Competitive salary

- Lunch in the office

- Flexible time off

- Team events

Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it.

UK Based, occasional travel to our London office.

In this role, you will support government contracts throughout their lifecycle, from identifying opportunities and coordinating proposal submissions to contract administration, compliance, and customer support. Working closely with Commercial, Operations, Logistics, and Finance teams, you will help deliver exceptional service to government customers while supporting business growth and contractual compliance.

• Assist the wider Sales Support team during peak tender periods and business-critical activities.

• Develop broad business knowledge to support operational continuity and team flexibility.

• Strong organisational skills and exceptional attention to detail.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

• A proactive, collaborative, and customer-focused approach.

• Ability to work independently while building strong relationships across teams.

Experience & Qualifications

• 1-3+ years of experience in contract administration, bid/proposal coordination, sales support, customer operations, project coordination, or a related field.

• Ability to manage documentation and data accurately within structured systems.

Why Join World Fuel?

• Opportunity to work with government and public sector customers across a global business.

description:
At U.S. Bank, we’re on a journey to do our best. Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions, enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed in the right ways, all more confidently and more often-that’s what we call the courage to thrive. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at-all from Day One.
As a wholly owned subsidiary of U.S. Bank, Elavon is committed to building the platforms and ecosystems that help over 1.5 million customers around the world to achieve their financial goals-no matter what they need. From transaction processing to customer service, to driving innovation and launching new products, we’re building a range of tailored payment solutions powered by the latest technology. As part of our team, you can explore what motivates and energizes your career goals: partnering with our customers, our communities, and each other.
We actively uphold transparent and fair hiring practices that support individual opportunity, inclusive culture, and career mobility across all levels of our organisation.
We offer meaningful opportunities for growth, a culture of inclusion, and a strong commitment to transparency and integrity in everything we do.
Job Description
Proactively generate new business sales within Elavon ’s SMB segment through self‑sourced opportunities and partner‑led referrals.Self‑generate pipeline through prospecting, outbound sales activity, and leveraging existing professional networks.Build and maintain relationships with lead and referral partners to consistently source new business opportunities.Manage the full sales lifecycle, from initial engagement through to deal closure, selling a range of acquiring services and payment solutions.Achieve agreed new customer acquisition and revenue targets, which are the primary measures of success for this role.Maintain accurate pipeline activity and forecasting in line with internal sales processes.Act as a self‑starter with strong ownership of personal performance, continuously identifying new opportunities and routes to market.

Drive for Results
Pursues goals with energy and perseverance; rarely gives up before succeeding; works to overcome barriers and challenges in order to produce desired results; can be counted on to achieve or surpass goals; consistently a top performer among peer group.
Collaboration
Develops good working relationships with others; recognizes and values differences; encourages an inclusive collaborative environment and open dialogue; puts team’s goals ahead of personal agendas; shares information openly and transparently; openly supports team members and their efforts.
Agility & Innovation
Demonstrate flexibility in dealing with fast-changing priorities, and different or challenging situations. Help others to continuously improve and achieve results. Explore multiple solutions to overcome obstacles. Anticipate future needs that may affect the team or organization.
Inclusion
Build a culture of equity and inclusion in which diverse ideas, talent and perspectives are welcomed and encouraged.
Risk Management
Appropriately identify and manage risks, in compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, and with Company Policy.
Ethics and Trust
Maintain high ethical standards; gain the confidence and trust of others through honesty, integrity and authenticity. Conducts him or herself honestly and ethically; adheres to a core set of values and standards appropriate to the situation and acts; accordingly, is consistent in own words and actions; inspires trust and respect by dealing openly with people; keeps confidences and admits mistakes.

title: Senior Engineer - ESD
description:
About Megaport
We’re not your typical tech company - and we don’t want to be. Megaport is the global leader in Network as a Service (NaaS), and has transformed the way businesses connect to the cloud, data centers, and each other. We’re publicly listed on the Australian Stock Exchange and partnered with the biggest names in tech like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Oracle, IBM, and more. Headquartered in Brisbane with a crew of over 600 people spread across Asia-Pacific, Europe, and the Americas, our employees enjoy an environment that is collaborative, supportive, and (actually) fun.
 
Our Team Culture
We’re a team of problem solvers, pixel pushers, code slingers, and cloud fanatics. Culture is more than a poster on the wall here - collaboration beats hierarchy, curiosity fuels our growth, and everyone’s voice matters. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. We work across time zones to execute on our global vision, trust each other to get things done, and never compromise our values for commercial gain. Most importantly, we place our customers at the center of everything we do.
 
We’re committed to increasing representation in the tech industry and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Don’t meet every requirement? That’s okay. If you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply.

The Role
We are seeking a highly experienced engineer to join our Edge Services team, responsible for building and evolving Megaport’s edge compute platform. This platform underpins our Virtual Network Function (VNF) products and the networking systems that power them globally.
In this role, you will operate at the intersection of distributed systems, networking, and cloud-native infrastructure. You will be a key technical leader shaping the compute and networking stack, driving architectural decisions, and ensuring scalability, reliability, and performance across our edge platform. Beyond deep technical contribution, you will act as a central advisor within your domain - guiding strategy, mentoring engineers, and influencing outcomes across teams.

#LI-DNI

If you have any questions, please reach out to Megaport's Talent Acquisition Team at Careers@megaport.com
 
NOTE: All Megaport business correspondence is conducted via our business email accounts (@megaport.com). If you have any concerns, please reach out to Megaport's careers team careers@megaport.com directly and we will verify the legitimacy of any communication. Megaport will not ask you to create an account via Microsoft teams, and does not associate with any email accounts under "@megaportau.com".
 
All applications will be treated in confidence.
Please see Part 2 of our Privacy Policy to see what information Megaport collects from job applicants, why, and how we store and use it. Note that you’re entitled to know what personal data of yours Megaport holds, to request updates, rectification, and in some circumstances restriction or deletion thereof if you object (you being entitled to withdraw your consent to our holding your information at any time). Please see Part 5 of our Privacy Policy for more details on this and how to contact Megaport's data protection officer if you have any further privacy-related questions. Candidates who meet the selection criteria will be invited to attend an interview. Strictly no Recruitment Agencies.

title: CDI - Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist - Strategy & Consulting - Paris
description:
Qui sommes-nous ?

Artefact est un cabinet de conseil international spécialisé en Data et Intelligence Artificielle, présent dans plus de 20 pays avec plus de 2 500 collaborateurs.

Nous accompagnons nos clients dans leur transformation en combinant expertise technologique, conseil et connaissance métier, sur des enjeux allant de la stratégie Data & IA à la conception et au déploiement de solutions concrètes.

Nos équipes réunissent notamment des Business Consultants, Data Analysts, Data Scientists et Data Engineers, qui interviennent auprès de grands groupes internationaux dans des secteurs variés.

Notre ambition : mettre la Data et l’IA au service de problématiques business concrètes et créer un impact mesurable pour nos clients.

Ton rôle

Au sein de l’équipe Talent Acquisition France et sous la responsabilité de la Head of Talent Acquisition, tu pilotes en autonomie le recrutement des équipes Strat Data d’Artefact, sur des profils allant de Junior à Manager.

Partenaire des équipes opérationnelles, tu les accompagnes tout au long du processus afin de garantir des recrutements de qualité et une expérience candidat exigeante :

Piloter les recrutements de bout en bout

• Recueillir et challenger les besoins auprès des managers

• Définir et mettre en œuvre l’approche de recrutement adaptée à chaque besoin

• Piloter l’ensemble du processus : sourcing, qualification, entretiens RH, coordination des étapes d’évaluation et offre

• Développer une approche proactive du sourcing et constituer des viviers de profils pertinents.

title: Enrollment Specialist
description:
Enrollment Specialist (Remote)
Location: Dominican Republic or South Africa
Schedule: Full-Time | US Business Hours
Work Setup: 100% Remote
Hiring Preference: Female Candidates Only
We are a growing network of early childhood education schools across the United States and are seeking a highly motivated Enrollment Specialist to join our team.
As the first point of contact for prospective families, you will answer inquiries via phone, email, and web, follow up with leads, schedule campus tours, and guide families through the enrollment process. You will work closely with school leadership teams and maintain accurate records in our CRM system.
This role involves spending most of your day speaking with American families, so excellent spoken and written English is required.
Key Responsibilities:

• Respond to inbound inquiries from prospective families

• Conduct outbound follow-up calls and emails

• Schedule campus tours and appointments

• Guide families through the enrollment process

• Maintain accurate CRM records and lead tracking

• Collaborate with school leaders to support enrollment goals

Requirements:

• 1+ year of customer service experience

• Experience in sales, lead generation, or customer acquisition

• Excellent verbal and written English communication skills

• Warm, professional, and persuasive communication style

• Strong organizational and multitasking abilities

• Ability to manage a high volume of leads and follow-ups

• Comfortable working independently in a remote environment

Preferred:

• Experience with Salesforce CRM

• Experience working with U.S.-based customers

• Background in admissions, enrollment, education, or call center environments

If you are a strong communicator who enjoys helping families and thrives in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Director, AI Innovation and Transformation (UK Remote)
description:
We are seeking a Director of AI Innovation and Transformation to play a critical leadership role in translating cutting-edge AI capabilities into tangible business outcomes, fostering a culture of innovation at Turnitin. This new role will begin as an individual contributor position, with the opportunity to build and lead a team as it evolves.
The candidate is accountable for translating Turnitin's AI ambition into a prioritized enterprise roadmap and measurable business outcomes, informed by departmental strategies. Working in partnership with departmental leaders, the Director will establish a consistent approach to identifying, evaluating, prioritizing and scaling AI opportunities across the organization.
Key Responsibilities:

• Develop and maintain a prioritized enterprise AI transformation roadmap aligned with Turnitin's long-range financial plan and strategic objectives. You will work with department owners to synthesize their individual roadmaps into a single, cohesive company roadmap focused on collective outcomes.

• Be knowledgeable about the industry to make recommendations to departments on where they could focus their efforts.

• Work with department AI Champions to connect operating models to future-state processes to drive transformation approaches that are practical and credible.

• From department level pilots, establish a framework for approvals, data requirements, and define company success metrics.

• Facilitate collaboration between department stakeholders to share knowledge and build capacity

• Build the capabilities necessary to move successful ideas from pilot to production to scaled adoption.

• Establish the operating model, ways of working, skills, and culture needed to sustain our AI focus across the enterprise.

• Evaluate emerging AI technologies and and work with department stakeholders to assess their fit for Turnitin

• Develop and oversee enterprise-wide AI literacy, upskilling, and enablement programs in partnership with departments across the company"

• Be knowledgeable about AI tools, agents, efficacy of tools and costs to create a consolidated toolset for departments to use.

• Oversee program level delivery including governance, planning and reporting

• Embed AI-driven decision-making into core processes, accelerating value creation, and ensuring robust governance, ethical standards, and regulatory compliance across all AI initiatives.

• Ensure AI initiatives deliver measurable business impact, including revenue growth, cost optimization, risk reduction, and improved customer experience.

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

• 12+ overall work experience including 5+ years experience in SaaS leadership

• Significant experience leading AI strategy, digital transformation, automation, or technology-enabled business transformation, with demonstrated success translating emerging technologies into measurable business outcomes.

• Proven ability to identify high-value opportunities, develop business cases, prioritise investments, and measure the financial, operational and productivity impact of technology initiatives.

• Experience influencing senior leaders and partnering across multiple functions to align priorities, drive adoption and deliver cross-organisational change in a federated or decentralised operating model.

• Ability to synthesize complex, cross-functional activities into a unified technology roadmap.

• Exceptional ability to lead cross-functional committees and influence leaders at all levels across all business units.

• A strong focus on driving measurable ROI, efficiency, and productivity gains through technology, rather than purely academic or research-oriented exploration.

• Experience implementing governance, data privacy standards, and best practices in an entrepreneurial, fast-paced environment without stifling innovation.
